items.label: Netweb Technologies India Q1 FY2027 (07-29-2026)
items.signal_prefix: CMD Sanjay Lodha's guidance: margins will remain between 13% to 14%

set.signal: CMD Sanjay Lodha's guidance: margins will remain between 13% to 14% (some basis points up or down); about 60% of the pipeline is expected to convert, over 18 to 24 months 'but not beyond that'; order-book execution is now guided at 16 to 20 weeks (earlier 8 to 12 weeks), 'it can stretch a little bit or can be early'. Existing facilities were built to sustain a turnover of INR3,000-plus crores, so no major capex is needed - only light and routine capex, and he is 'not guiding on any new capex'. CMD: worldwide AI compute demand is phenomenal and 'for at least for next 1.5 to 2 years, it will remain the same'.

items.reason: The call never says the company does not guide revenue in general: the CMD's 'We are not guiding on revenue at all' answers a question about the new physical-AI / quantum opportunities (already stated on the products entry); on capex he said he is 'not guiding on any new capex'.
items.evidence: Sanjay Lodha: We are not guiding on revenue at all these are the new opportunities which we are talking about ... | ... But basically, I'm not guiding on any new capex as such recently.
